Some letters that Zenon himself sent turn up in his own archive. He wrote to his predecessor on the
estate, and that man's papers later passed into Zenon's hands.
That fact can only be seen by someone who knows where each letter sits among the others. Read alone, in
whichever collection it lies, a papyrus is a document about an unknown man's errands.
